memberships.page_title: Can the Nodal Puiseux Solution Be Ruled Out Globally?

statement: The proposed finite-order three-level 2:3 Puiseux rigidity lemma is false: for every immersed limit parametrization the recurrence extends at each finite order, and the nodal model (xi^2,xi^3-xi) has an explicit all-orders algebraic-series solution.
